description: La production d'énergie électrique au Luxembourg is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Leneda. The Leneda platform is Luxembourg's national energy data platform. It is a central point for the management and exchange of electricity and gas data between different energy market participants. The platform is deployed and operated by Creos Luxembourg S.A., in its capacity as transmission system operator for electricity and gas. Coverage: Leneda. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity generation in Luxembourg" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Leneda. Its keywords include leneda. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
